dimensions.name: Task Success (outcome verifier, pass rate over trials)
dimensions.scoring_formula: pass_rate = trials whose verifier reward >= the entry's pass_threshold (default 1) / trials; score = round(100 * pass_rate)

score_synthesis.formula: total_score = D1. Per-trial reward is binary and comes only from the entry's verifier, run inside the task environment after the agent stops (outcome-based, the agent never sees it).
notes: Multiple trials are needed because single agent runs are high-variance; 3 trials is the default.
Infrastructure failures (sandbox start, build) are recorded per trial as infra_error and count as 0; rerun any trial that shows infra_error.
No LLM-as-judge dimensions: every entry has an objective, verifier-defined outcome.
C6 entries were picked because pass rates differed sharply across gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.8-flash and claude-opus-5-5 (3 trials each). Use C6 to rank models.
Each entry keeps its pre-restructure ID in former_id (see results/id_mapping.json).

verifier_contract.runs_in: the task environment after the agent finishes; the agent never sees the verifier
verifier_contract.reward: binary 0/1, or continuous in [0,1] with a per-entry pass_threshold (DeepSWE-style entries)
